entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Acting guildmaster and Grand Arbiter Pro Tem of the Azorius Senate, formerly an arrester and Jace Beleren's deputy.

entities.name: Jek
entities.description: Lavinia's brother, an Azorius who ran afoul of the Dimir and Rakdos and died for his sister's safety.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who became Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: An ogre who helped Jace escape from Lavinia.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster assassinated by Vraska.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon who announced the maze and was resurrected as the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Manipulated the maze runners into chaos; later helped shut off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Accompanied Jace through the Azorius Guildgate.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Planeswalker who became Azorius guildmaster and was defeated during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who assassinated Isperia.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas' main agent who placed a device on Lavinia's neck.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose agents infiltrated the guilds.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Izzet planeswalker warned by Lavinia, who freed her from Tezzeret's device.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rakdos emissary killed by Lavinia while possessed.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped activate the Interplanar Beacon and defeated Oba.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker Lavinia was tasked to cooperate with.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective who invited Lavinia to Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani who organized the Karlov Manor murders; defeated by Kaya and Etrata.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Helped Kaya defeat Oba.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Assassinated at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican governing guild Lavinia serves.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Triggered when Jace linked the maze runners' minds, restoring the Guildpact's magic.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A maze built by Azor with the Supreme Verdict as its goal.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact shut off during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The conflict in which Lavinia helped shut off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that Lavinia used to reform the Azorius.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Lavinia serves.

events.summary: Lavinia's brother Jek dies paying for her safety; she kills the torturers and leaves to become an arrester.
events.quote: her brother ultimately paid for his sister's safety with his life.

events.summary: Lavinia investigates Jace after an arson; Ruric Thar helps Jace escape and wounds arresters.
events.quote: Ruric Thar shrugged off the magic and wounded several of the arresters assigned to Lavinia.

events.summary: Lavinia is reassigned to the towers of New Prahv to keep her out of the case.
events.quote: she was reassigned and confined in the towers of New Prahv

events.summary: Lavinia is chosen to run the maze for the Azorius and arrests Jace at the Azorius Guildgate.
events.quote: Lavinia took the opportunity to, at last, arrest Jace

events.summary: Isperia sentences Jace to community service; Jace links the runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming the first Living Guildpact.
events.quote: empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

events.summary: Lavinia becomes Jace's aide and deputy.
events.quote: She became Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber of the Guildpact .

events.summary: Lavinia refuses to recognize Dovin Baan's authority after Vraska assassinates Isperia and leads a rebel faction.
events.quote: she also refused to acknowledge Dovin Baan 's authority

events.summary: Tezzeret traps Lavinia and places a device on her neck, making her an unwilling accomplice of Bolas.
events.quote: Tezzeret outmatched her and placed a device on her neck

events.summary: Possessed Lavinia kills Hekara before Ral Zarek frees her.
events.quote: This led to Hekara being killed by Lavinia

events.summary: During the War of the Spark Lavinia helps shut off the Immortal Sun after defeating Dovin Baan.
events.quote: They managed to do so after defeating Dovin Baan

events.summary: Lavinia becomes acting guildmaster of the Azorius.
events.quote: She survived the War and became acting guildmaster of the Azorius.

events.summary: Lavinia reforms the Azorius during the New Phyrexian Invasion, ridding it of Dovin Baan's influence.
events.quote: ridding it of the last traces of Dovin Baan's influence.

events.summary: Zegana is assassinated at Karlov Manor and Lavinia leads the investigation.
events.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated

events.summary: Alquist Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Lavinia, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
events.quote: Lavinia was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.
